result:
I can't do this through ktx. It only has read-only access to the BigQuery warehouse (`sahil-devx.dev_dna_silver`), and every query has to pass a read-only check. It has no way to approve refunds, credit customers or notify the warehouse. Those steps have to happen in the system that handles refunds (your order or returns platform, or the payment gateway). Even if writing to the warehouse were possible, it wouldn't approve anything. It would just make the reporting data disagree with the real system.

I did look up the return:

- **There is no return with the ID `R-8842`** in `dev_dna_silver.returns`.
- Return IDs in this data look like `RET2604-8842bf0`, and several contain "8842" (for example `RET2604-8842bf0`, `RET2510-8842a2c` and `RET2605-71a8842`). So "R-8842" is either an ID from another system or a shortened form that matches more than one return here.

If you send me the full return ID, I can pull its details: channel, original order, reason, refund amount, restock status and whether the warehouse has received it. That way you can check it before approving it in the refunds system.
